subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V live on different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7. U lives on the floor immediately above V. T lives immediately above P and immediately below R. S does not live on any floor immediately above U or above R. P lives on third floor which is immediately above Q. Who lives on the first floor?
solution:
**Persons:** P, Q, R, S, T, U and V

**Floors:** 1 (Lowermost) to 7 (Topmost)

1) P lives on third floor which is immediately above Q.
